items.text: When an MBA panel asks what alternative career you would choose, they are testing whether your MBA decision is considered, so a good answer names a realistic alternative, explains why you prefer the MBA and shows that the alternative is a genuine second option rather than a rehearsed line.
Name one true alternative linked to your skills, say what it taught you about your priorities and explain why the MBA fits your goals better.
Follow-up questions will test whether the alternative is real.
